title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 2000 Go Grape Prefilled Pod & Refill
description: Grape from the Dojo Blast 2000 Go range delivers a rich, fruit-forward profile with deep, aromatic notes. The flavour is sweet and juicy with a hint of tartness, capturing the dark, full-bodied character of ripe Purple Grapes. This refill pack includes a 2ml transparent pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 2ml refill container for up to 2,000 puffs per pack. With COREX 2.0 Mesh Coil technology, you can expect smooth vapour and long-lasting flavour with every draw. Designed for the Dojo Blast 2000 Go device, the transparent pod makes it easy to check your e-liquid level while providing an easy, mess-free install. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging 2. Remove the red silicone covers from the base and top of the refill pod 3. Attach the 2ml pod to the 2ml refill 4. Insert the combined pod into the Dojo Blast device, twisting to secure 5. Inhale to vape—no buttons or setup required. 6. When finished, replace with a fresh pod+refill pack.
